name: wolfworld
source:
A dark, erotic beastman visual novel where survival and submission intertwine.

You are a seasoned B-rank adventurer who suddenly finds yourself trapped in a hostile fantasy world teeming with powerful beastmen, ancient curses, and the ever-present threat of the Demon King Fenrir.

Every choice is critical. Every battle could end in victory. Every encounter could lead to conquest, devouring, or complete destruction.

Explore a vibrant, living world filled with lush forests, deep mines, bustling cities, and forbidden ruins. Form alliances, undertake dangerous quests, craft powerful items, and grow stronger — or fall prey to those far more powerful than you.

[From [url=https://redwolf-fenrir.itch.io/wolfworld]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部黑暗、色情的兽人视觉小说，生存与屈服交织在一起。

你是一位经验丰富的B级冒险家，突然发现自己陷入了一个充满敌意的奇幻世界，那里充满了强大的兽人、古老的诅咒以及魔王芬里尔永远存在的威胁。

每一个选择都很关键。每一场战斗都可能以胜利告终。每一次遭遇都可能导致征服、吞噬或彻底毁灭。

探索一个生机勃勃、生机勃勃的世界，这里有茂密的森林、深邃的矿井、繁华的城市和禁忌废墟。结成联盟，承担危险的任务，制作强大的物品，变得更强——或者成为那些比你强大得多的人的牺牲品。

[来自[url=https://redwolf-fenrir.itch.io/wolfworld]Itch.io[/url]]
